inheritance_judgment.basis: Single-GPU world1 execution and identical native reader/inference remain unchanged. Both candidate hosts have recorded same A800-SXM4-80GB hardware and identical base package environment; native 6714 world1 deployment was already executed on tsinghua-zt4. inheritance_judgment.numeric_limit: Same seeds/source/environment define the same protocol; FA2/host/run floating-point outputs are not guaranteed bitwise identical. Each endpoint is pinned to one route before first invocation.
inheritance_judgment.performance_limit: Do not claim the vla-zt/tsinghua-zt FP32 export latency or cold-load cost equals rl-zt2 or warm dev16. Record initial native/shared-read load and complete1696 end-to-end timing in the first already-declared endpoint; do not create another candidate or benchmark.

minimum_future_changes.change: A new reviewed helper version may use a literal canonical map for rl-zt2, vla-zt, tsinghua-zt only, plus one immutable per-job route record selected by Lead before first export. Bind hostname, GPU index+UUID, source/environment, exact job/intent/native receipt, validity window and controller slot. Check live authorization/prohibitions and socket hostname. No wildcard tsinghua family or automatic host fallback.

Keep export attempts, explicit same-identity resume and CPU scoring on the one recorded host. Retain both exporter-host equality checks, local /proc exit check, and rank_0 lock. Do not relax the checks to permit remote exporter liveness guesses or migrate an existing partial job.

Retain the existing two shared dev_score_slot_0/1 locks (2 workers each) and add exactly four shared dev_export_slot_0..3 locks under the same campaign root, held across the child process via pass_fds. Keep host-local /tmp/foresight_gpu_N.lock. All admitted export launchers must participate; otherwise Lead must serialize admission and reject an unaccounted legacy active export. Do not make four slots per host.

Lead fresh admission must confirm prior scientific processes/descendants naturally exited, no active training lease on the selected slot, expected GPU UUID/model, GPU memory/utilization free, host memory, CPU quota and disk headroom. Preserve existing 64 GiB export /16 GiB score MemAvailable checks and existing independent disk reservations; account simultaneous loads before additional admission. No pressure/process stop is part of this proposal.

Before the first endpoint on the chosen host, read-only confirm clean 6714 SHA/source pins, exact Python/package/CUDA/cuDNN environment and relevant FA2 extension, same shared mount with global flock semantics, and reachability of immutable base/native receipts, dev manifest/current inputs/maps/metric index. Check small metadata and stat only; frozen runtime retains full payload verification at actual use. Fail closed on mismatches.

Retain world1/rank0/seed42/FP32 master/TF32 off/Euler10, full1696, 1728 total admitted calls with retry1, at most two export and two score invocations,1 GiB/job reservation,7800 s export and4200 s score outer limits.
